en.t: His tone was full of self-satisfaction.

units.source_text: 两女公子看了觉得这话岂有此理。

en.t: When the two young ladies read it, they felt that his words were simply outrageous.

units.source_text: 但此时寂寞无事，看了这封精美的来信，

en.t: But at the time they were lonely and had nothing to do, and after reading this beautifully written letter,

units.source_text: 觉得不便置之不理，且做表面的敷衍。

en.t: they felt it would be improper to ignore it, so they gave him a merely perfunctory reply.
